title: 5 App-to-Web Experiment Results
summary: App Monetization for the AI Era — The most interesting shift in consumer app monetization isn’t a new paywall design. It’s where the transaction happens.
body_markdown:
##### 1. Lifestyle Social App (Health & Fitness)


**Three-page trial paywall defaulting to annual.**


The cleanest win of the group, with flat trial starts (+0.2%), but trial-to-paid conversion up 9.2%, overall conversion to paid +11.9%, and revenue per user +24%. Proceeds per user landed at +44.2%. Huge win.


##### 2. Business Productivity App (Shopping)


**Two-page trial-oriented paywall with only two annual offerings.**


Conversion to trial -8% relative, conversion to paid -3%, revenue per user +9%. Proceeds per user: +41.4%.


#####


##### 3. Health Tracking App (Health & Fitness)


**One-page in-app and out-of-app paywall highlighting a paid trial.**


Trial starts dropped -5.2%, but despite fewer people in the funnel, trial conversion rose +8%, ARPU +18%, and proceeds per user +39%.


Fewer trials, better better. The web flow filtered out some of the low-intent starts and converted the rest at a much higher rate.


#####


##### 4. Language Learning App (Education)


**Trial-oriented paywall with monthly and annual options with a second-try discount.**


With trial starts (+8%), conversion to paid (+16%), and revenue per user (+28%) all up, proceeds per user came in at +56%.


#####


##### 5. Health Coaching App (Health & Fitness)


**One-page in-app paywall linking to a single annual apple pay subscription.**


Trial starts at +0.4%, trial conversion -1.1%, revenue per user flat, yet proceeds per user: +31.4%.
